Everything in this release carries the same edition date, including sheets that
did not change — so a sheet and the rulebook can always be told to be from the
same set.

**Printing.** The rulebook is US Letter. Each record sheet is a single page;
print one per Frame you field.

**Verifying what you have.** The edition date is printed on the rulebook cover,
in its running footer, and in the footer of every sheet. If a printout says
`Draft`, it was built locally rather than released.
